name: Onna Kyoushi
source:
The story unfolds at Soka Academy—an institution renowned throughout the prefecture as a prestigious seat of learning. Within the walls of this academy, there were two students.

Date Yuichiro carried a dark past: he had once been framed as a rapist by a female teacher and subsequently expelled from the school.

Mizuki Hiromi—a shy and frail student—looked noticeably younger than his peers in the same grade, making him a constant target for bullying by his classmates.

Driven by a desire to exact vengeance upon the very concept of "female teachers," Yuichiro set out on a mission.

Hiromi, meanwhile, sought to protect the only person at the academy who truly understood him: the school nurse, Asakura Rina.

Together, they began to plunge the female teachers into a swirling vortex of carnal desire...

translation:
故事发生在索卡学院——一所享誉全县的名校。学院里有两名学生。

伊达祐一郎有着黑暗的过去：他曾被一名女教师诬陷为强奸犯，随后遭到退学处分。

水树浩巳性格羞怯、身体孱弱，看上去明显比同年级学生年幼，因此一直是同学霸凌的对象。

祐一郎想向“女教师”这一存在本身复仇，并为此采取行动。

浩巳则想保护学院中唯一真正理解自己的人：校医朝仓理奈。

两人就此开始将女教师们拖入肉欲的漩涡……
